spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with Technical Grid Borders for data. Ensure tables and cards are highly legible.

components.cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border (border-gray-200), no default shadow. Hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, border-gray-300 transition-all duration-200.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-md px-6 py-2 hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 rounded-md px-6 py-2 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.danger: bg-red-800 text-white rounded-md px-6 py-2 hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors font-medium shadow-sm

components.tables: Use Shadcn UI tables. Left-align text, tabular-nums for financial data. 1px border on cells for 'Grid Borders' technical look. Sticky header.
components.sidebar: Light sidebar, border-r border-gray-200. Links: text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 rounded-md. Active: bg-blue-50 text-blue-900 font-medium.
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI forms. Inputs: border-gray-300 rounded-md focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:border-transparent. Upload areas should use dashed borders.
components.badges: Rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Active/In-Stock: bg-green-100 text-green-800. Sold: bg-gray-100 text-gray-800.

pages.login: Minimalist split layout. Left side: Login form, clean white background, clear typography. Right side: Vintage sports texture/stadium image overlay.
pages.dashboard: Summary overview. Top bar (user, date). Hero row (Total Assets, Net Profit, Cash Balance). Middle: Line Chart (Income vs Expense). Bottom: Recent transactions list.
pages.ready_stock: Inventory management. Contains a table with columns: Item Name, Image (thumbnails), Purchase Price, Shipping Cost, Remake, Status, Total. Include an 'Add Item' button with image upload.
pages.beginning_balance: Form/View layout with cards for Kas, Kas Bank, Piutang (Accounts Receivable), Persediaan Jersey (Inventory), Perlengkapan Jersey, Perlengkapan, Total Aset.
pages.cash_book: Ledger table (Buku Kas Bank). Columns: Tanggal, Deskripsi, Pemasukan, Pengeluaran, Saldo. Use text-green-700 for Pemasukan and text-red-700 for Pengeluaran.
pages.profit_loss: Structured financial statement view. Distinct rows for Penjualan, HPP, Laba Kotor, Biaya-biaya, Total Pengeluaran, Pendapatan Lain, Laba Bersih/Rugi.
pages.balance_sheet: Neraca report view. Standard format displaying Assets (Aktiva) and Liabilities/Equity (Pasiva).

login_bg.description: Vintage sports texture for login background

stadium_bg.description: Soccer stadium at sunset, optional background or hero element

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='sidebar-dashboard-link').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using React (.js files), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components.
Use Indonesian language for all text and labels (Rupiah IDR currency formatting).
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans' for headings. Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Outfit' is used for headings, and 'Manrope' for body text.
Follow the 'Technical Grid Borders' surface strategy for dashboard cards and tables.
Ensure generous spacing (p-6, p-8) within cards.
Mock JWT login flow and dashboard data for the frontend prototype.
Use the provided vintage jersey placeholder images in the Ready Stock table.
Format all IDR currencies correctly (e.g., Rp 1.500.000).
